meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: Claude 可以通过 Benchling Python SDK 和 REST API，帮你管理注册实体（如 DNA/RNA/蛋白）、库存容器、实验记录和工作流，还能查询数据仓库数据并配置事件集成。
howto.when: 当你说要自动化 Benchling 上的实验室数据时——比如管理注册实体、库存、实验记录，或查询数据仓库数据。使用前需已配置好 Benchling 账号、租户 URL 和 API 密钥或 OAuth 凭据。

say.text: 把容器 cont_abc123 转移到盒子 box_xyz789
查询数据仓库最近一个月的实验数据，汇总趋势
say.note: 执行 SQL 查询并反馈结果

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use Benchling's Python SDK and REST API to manage registry entities (DNA/RNA/proteins), inventory, ELN entries, workflows, query the Data Warehouse, and set up event integrations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate lab data in Benchling, such as managing registry entities, inventory, or notebook entries, or querying the Data Warehouse. Requires a Benchling account, tenant URL, and API key or OAuth credentials.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence named pGFP with bases ATCGATCG using the Benchling SDK
Query the Data Warehouse for last month's experiment data and summarize trends
say_en.note: Runs SQL query and returns results
